content.short: Astria is the Shared Sequencer Network replaces centralized sequencers and maintains sovereignty.
content.description: Astria enables rollups to share a single decentralized network of sequencers that is simple and permissionless to join. Rollups connected to the Shared Sequencer Network enjoy rapid block confirmations and the censorship resistance guarantees offered by a decentralized network. This arrangement reduces reliance on a single sequencing entity, distributing control across a broad, permissionless community to support secure, efficient rollup operation.
content.meta: Astria is a shared sequencer network built to improve rollup performance and sovereignty. Discover Astria and other RaaS Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
